source.title: Dubai Building Code 2021 Edition (English)
source.notes: pdf_page is the 1-based page index of the PDF; printed_page is the PDF page label (Part K = pdf 671-842). Part K is standalone for villas (K.4); Part B/C rules apply only where Part K cross-references them. Every quote was verified verbatim (whitespace-normalised) against its pdf_page by reference/dbc/build_rules.py.
source.units: values carry their own unit; op is one of >=, <=, <, >, ==, range [lo, hi], in

rules.rule: A damp-proof course must be at least 150 mm above adjoining ground where walls are not under groundwater pressure.
rules.quote: provided at least 150 mm above the level of the adjoining ground

current_design.note: GF 900 over street, 200 over pool garden

rules.rule: All villas need smoke detection and alarm, a panel near the front door and outside audio-visual devices.
rules.quote: requires a smoke detection and alarm system in all villas/townhouses

rules.rule: Sprinklers and hose reels are required where ground floor GA or basement GA exceeds 1,500 m2.
rules.quote: townhouses with a ground floor GA >1,500 m2

rules.rule: Where fences or boundary walls are provided, height is limited to 3 m (Part B; not cross-referenced by Part K).
rules.applies_to: buildings under Part B (informative for villas)
rules.condition: DCR/affection plan governs villa boundary walls
rules.quote: the fence height shall be limited to a maximum of 3 m

not_covered: Maximum plot coverage, FAR or GFA cap for villas (K.5.2.7 defines coverage only; limits come from the DCR/affection plan)
Villa building height other than the 16 m total cap and the three-storey scope (K.5.2.2 defers to the DCR)
Boundary wall/fence height for villas (Part K silent; B.10.3's 3 m cap is Part B and not cross-referenced)
Minimum floor areas for bathrooms, WCs, maid/driver bathrooms, laundry, store, plant, majlis or dining (bathrooms go by fixture clearances only)
A separate driver-room standard (drivers fall under the housekeeper's room definition, K.2.2)
Openable window area / natural-ventilation opening as a % of floor area (K.10.1.7: natural ventilation not relied upon)
Kitchen/bathroom exhaust airflow rates (deferred to ASHRAE 62.2-2019; no values in the DBC)
2R+G (Blondel) stair rule, maximum risers per flight, minimum number of flights
Door heights and door-head clearance; internal door widths other than Table K.4
Roof parapet height as such (only the 1,200 mm guard for accessible roofs); any requirement to provide roof access
Private pool maximum depth, diving depth, pool-to-boundary setback beyond the 1.2 m walkway (Figure K.41), crest/overflow geometry
Shading projection depth rules (K.7.2.3 only recommends external shading)
Corridor/circulation area ratios, bedroom-to-bathroom ratios, en-suite requirements
Sunken court / lightwell minimum dimensions for villas
Window-to-window privacy/overlooking distances (K.5.1 and K.5.2.5.1(f) are qualitative)
Vehicular gate width and car porch/canopy height
Maximum window/glazing ratio (glazing performance is tied to WWR, no cap)
